name: Funan, Khmer Empire (Angkor) & Majapahit
summary: At the crossroads of the Indian and Pacific Oceans, the Khmer Empire engineered vast baray reservoirs and Angkor Wat (the largest religious monument on Earth), while Srivijaya and Majapahit united the Indonesian spice archipelago.
